title: Dependence of the squared Fourier factor
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of $k$ vertices each, and fix one part. The square of its Fourier factor depends only on the labels assigned to matching edges incident to that part: any two edge assignments agreeing on those edges give the same squared factor.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A perfect matching of the complete multipartite graph
